summary: Pearl Diver Credit Company Inc., a NYSE-listed closed-end fund (PDCC common, PDPA 8.00% Series A preferred due 2029), filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events disclosing management's unaudited net asset value per common share of $10.86 as of August 31, 2026. No transaction, solicitation, or corporate action is reported. The filing is signed by CEO Indranil Basu and dated September 15, 2026. This is an ordinary periodic NAV disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations apply. Watch for NAV drift and premium/discount to NAV.
